title: Workspace watcher ignores every file when any ABSOLUTE ancestor of the workspace is named target/dist/node_modules (workspace_watch.rs:393)
outcome: Workspace file-event filtering judges only path components inside the watched workspace root, so a repository that lives under a directory named target, dist, node_modules or a dot-directory (for example a runner clone at …/Engram-runner/target/termal-runner-clone) still reports its source file events, while build output inside the workspace stays ignored.
acceptance: Workspace watcher ignores every file when any ABSOLUTE ancestor of the workspace is named target/dist/node_modules (workspace_watch.rs:393) is done
disposal_reason: Duplicate filed within the same minute. Termal::Opus2 filed the same workspace-watcher absolute-'target'-ancestor bug (workspace_watch.rs:393, found by the Windows B run test-4d0311df) as w-a259a47bb144. This item's creation note holds the code reading (IGNORED_COMPONENTS matched over the whole absolute path, case-insensitively; the DL560 clone is also under target/) for the holder of w-a259a47bb144.
